Definition: Sheba, the name of three early progenitors of tribes and of an Ethiopian district
BiblicalUsage: Sheba = "seven" or "an oath"; n pr m; 1) son of Joktan and a descendant of Seth; 2) son of Raamah, grandson of Cush, and a descendant of Ham; 3) son of Jokshan, the son of Abraham by Keturah; n pr loc; 4) a nation in southern Arabia
